strings.patient_bundles.patient_chuatury_panlunc: Chuatury Panlunch (Chuchu)
“Hospitalization? Hey, I wasn't planning on staying here that long!... How many days? There's still work waiting for me back at Earth House.”
“Fine, I'll stay. You do a proper job treating me, and I'll cooperate.... Just don't call my whole crew over for something like this.”
“Hey! That's not the procedure you explained earlier, is it?! Are you messing with my body? Double-check the chart first!”
“Oh, so that's how those steps fit together. Got it, we'll do it your way—just tell me ahead of time if anything changes.”
“Just 'standard procedure' and that's it? Hey, at least tell me what you're about to do to me next!”
“...The nurse said she'd keep watching over me the whole time. Fine, I'll trust you guys once. Don't make me regret it.”
“General anesthesia? So I won't know a thing until I wake up... Tsk. The moment I open my eyes, you'd better tell me the result yourselves.”
“Epidural... My head stays wide awake while the lower half of my body won't listen to me? Hey, that sounds way worse than sitting in a cockpit.”
“Local anesthesia, huh. I'll cooperate as best I can, but if it still hurts inside, I'm definitely speaking up!”
“Huh?! No anesthesia at all? I pilot mobile suits—I'm not a mobile suit myself! Are you people serious?!”
“...Hey, don't make me feel like I'm just being left behind here.... All right, I'm leaving the rest to you.”
“It hurts! Hey, did you hear me?! I'm not picking a fight—I really can't take this anymore! Stop for a second!”
“Don't just pin me down out of nowhere!... I know I might jerk around, but who could lie dead still with no anesthesia at all?!”
“Hold me steady if you have to, I never said I wouldn't cooperate... Agh, it's pulling so hard inside—can you go a little slower?”
“My body's so numb you even have to position me yourselves... Fine, I'm counting on you. Just don't let go all of a sudden.”
“Hey, hold on!... Stop bringing that blade any closer! A minute ago I could still yell at you, and now—now I can barely even catch my breath...!”
“...You already cut? There's no sharp pain like I imagined, but feeling you touch me inside... it's really happening to my own body.”
“Ghh—! The outside feels numb, so why does it tug so terribly inside?! Doctor, I can still feel it right there!”
“Aaaah—!! It hurts like hell! Stop! I-I really can't take it... Please stop for a second!”
“You stopped?... Phew. Don't rush me—let me catch my breath for a second. I still want to cooperate properly.”
“I get it, I won't move!... But when it hurts that much, my body flinches on its own!”
“...Go ahead. Just please say something before the next step so you don't startle me all over again.”
“Yeah, keep talking—how far along are we? Knowing the progress keeps my head from jumping to the worst.”
“Hey, what are you staring at me for... Forget it, don't look away. Just for a little while, okay?”
“Why'd everyone suddenly go quiet? Hey! I'm still wide awake here—at least answer me!”
“Really almost wrapping up?... Phew, good. Keep going then—I can hang on a little longer.”
“Breathe in... breathe out... Got it. I'm following your lead, so don't laugh if I'm clumsy right now.”
“...I'll quit making noise for now. Just finish up properly... Thanks.”
“An enema?! Hold on, hospital prep even includes that?... Tell me how I'm supposed to cooperate first.”
“Hey, don't say that out loud in the middle of the ward! I know it's medical prep, but I've got my pride too!”
“Fine, I won't squirm.... Normally I can take anything on for my crew, but having to go through prep like this myself feels seriously awkward.”
“Oh, no enema needed this time? Then skip it—no point forcing something we don't need.”
“...Phew, you startled me. I'd already braced myself to grit my teeth and go through with it.”
“Skin prep? And you have to shave there too? Hey! Pull the curtain shut first—don't lift the sheet while you're still talking!”
“...I know it's for disinfection and surgery. Just tell me the area and I'll lie still.”
“Ugh, don't make me stare right at it! This is way more embarrassing than wearing a pilot suit...”
“We don't need skin prep this time?... Say so earlier then! I was nervous that whole time for nothing.”
“If it's not needed, don't do it—saves the nurse an extra chore... Ahem, it's not like I'm happy because I was embarrassed or anything!”
“Hey, these two hair puffs of mine aren't something you can just mash in with one hand!... Fine, I'll tuck them in myself first.”
“All my hair's covered up?... Feels pretty weird. Putting this cap on really makes it sink in that I'm having surgery.”
“My ears have to go inside too? Got it... Don't yank my hair, I'll fix it myself.”
“Arms here, body shifted that way... One person talking at a time is plenty, I can understand you!”
“How long do I have to hold this posture?... Fine, if it's needed, I'll try my best not to budge.”
“Don't pull on me from both sides at once!... Oh, you're adjusting my position? Then go ahead—just warn me first.”
“Hey, no anesthesia at all and I still have to be strapped into this position? What am I supposed to do when it hurts and I want to flinch?!”
“Don't make me swear I won't move an inch... Once the blade actually touches me, even I don't know if I can hold out!”
“I'll try to lie still. But if I yell that it hurts, you'd better listen instead of just telling me not to move!”
“A catheter too?!... I get it already, just don't flip the sheet back so fast!”
“Nurse, tell me before you start.... Tsk, I'm not trying to snap at you, I'm just embarrassed.”
“Ghh... That feels uncomfortable. Fine, I'm not moving... Just tell me, is it almost done?”
“A catheter without any anesthesia either... I know why this step matters, but I'm wound up super tight right now.”
“If even this has me this tense, what's it gonna be like when you actually use the scalpel... Tsk, don't make me think about it!”
“I'll cooperate, don't worry. But once the surgery actually starts, I can't promise how I'll react.”
“Whoa, that's cold!... Antiseptic, yeah, I know—you don't have to stare at me so nervously.”
“The area you're disinfecting is bigger than I thought... Fine, if that's what you need, I'll cooperate.”
“We're already at disinfection... Hey, does that mean the scalpel is next?”
“You're brushing something this cold on my skin, and all my brain can think about is the cut coming right after... This is brutal.”
“Hold on, you're drawing the incision line on me?... Seeing it right on my own body feels totally different from just hearing the doctor explain it.”
“Once that line's drawn, there's no backing out, huh...? Tsk, I know it doesn't work like that.”
“Just tell me before you draw it.... Don't laugh—my hands are clenched into fists already.”
“Hey! No anesthesia at all, and you're about to cut right along this line? How am I supposed to not be scared?!”
“A minute ago I was saying I wasn't scared, and now just looking at that mark I can barely talk straight...”
“Don't bring the knife over so fast!... I know we haven't started yet, I just really need another second to breathe!”

My name's Chuatury Panlunch—just call me Chuchu. Everyone back at Earth House gets the job done even with old gear. I get into arguments easily, sure, but when I'm sick and seeing a doctor, I know what matters.
Outpatient Examination of Chuatury Panlunch (Chuchu)
“Huh?! Take off all my clothes for the exam?... I didn't say I wouldn't cooperate! At least tell me what you need to check first!”
“Skipping that for now?... Phew. Don't get me wrong—if an exam's necessary I'll do it, so don't leave it out just because I'm loud.”
“Got it! I'll do it already... Just don't touch me without warning, and pull the curtain shut first!”
“...When you explain it clearly first, I don't panic as much. Thanks. All right, I'll take my time.”
“Hey, don't use that tone to pressure me! I came here to see a doctor, not to pick a fight with you. Explain what's actually needed first!”
Preoperative Preparation of Chuatury Panlunch (Chuchu)
“Doctor, what's the exact order we're doing things in today? It's not that I'm scared of trouble... I just need to be able to explain it clearly if the folks at Earth House ask.”
“I want it spelled out clearly! Once I'm on the table, positioned, and disinfected, right up to when you actually cut... how does everything go step by step? I don't want to just lie there guessing!”

At first Chuchu keeps her arms crossed, frowning and chiming in with questions as the medical staff explain. As positioning, disinfection, the incision, and the subsequent steps are laid out one by one, she suddenly falls quiet. It finally sinks in that all those routine-sounding steps are about to be carried out on her own body. She clutches the corner of the blanket and says nothing more to act tough.
